letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai or Ahmedabad reminds me that the true light lives in you. I cherish our mornings of chai and camel‑scented breezes, and evenings under glittering skylines, where your laughter is my favorite soundtrack. Even as the calendar flips to another beautiful season, my heart still skips a beat when you call me “cutie.” Thank you for turning ordinary moments into timeless memories—our love is the sweetest adventure I ever imagined.
poem:
In desert dunes or city streets we roam,  
Your smile turns every place into home.  
Through monsoon rains or desert’s heat,  
My love for you stays ever sweet.
